sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Raghvendra P. Singh,Vijay Pratap Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Vijay Pratap Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Rishikesh Verma,
the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
91 of 2023, under Section 34, 395, 412, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Naka Hindola, District Lucknow.
3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 21.06.2023, alleging that a robbery was committed by some unknown person.
4. The police claimed to have arrested seven persons on the basis of information received from a mukhbir on 20.06.2023 and to have recovered Rs. 23,55,000/- from them.
It is alleged that Rs. 1 lakh and a mobile phone was recovered from the applicant.
The recovery memo further states that no person witnessed the recovery proceeding.
Rakesh Kumar Parekh @ Rakesh Kumar ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
6. It has further been stated that the police had forcibly had taken away the applicant in the night of 20.06.2023 to Police station Naka Hindola and demanded illegal gratification for his release.

The applicant's mother-in-law withdrew Rs. 1 lakh cash from her bank account No. 30610422642 in State Bank of India, Mohanlalganj on 21.06.2023 and handed it over to the police for the applicant's release and the police has shown the same amount as having been recovered from the applicant.

The allegation levelled in para 11 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application is very serious in nature.
7.

On the basis of same recovery, the applicant was implicated in another case bearing Case Crime No. 212/2023 under Sections 34, 395, 412, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Bakshi ka Talab, District Lucknow, in which he has been granted bail by means of an order dated 09.08.2023 passed by this court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 10042 of 2023.

sentences.text: 8. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
10. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
